info.title: StudyCraft MVP API
info.summary: Design-first local API; no implementation claimed.
info.description: Proposed 2026-10-08. Source: ../requirements/user-stories.md, ../architecture/database-schema.md, ../SPEC.md, ADR006. Success domain schemas derive from SPEC; transport changes below are proposals, not deployed behavior. All examples are independent synthetic fixtures. Chỉ một người học local; không user accounts, cloud, uploads, streaming, job queue hoặc automatic model tools. Shared Problem uses RFC9457 style. See overview.md for concepts.

LocalSession.name: studycraft_session
LocalSession.description: Signed HttpOnly SameSite=Strict host-only cookie; Path=/; maxAge28800s proposed. Local browser session context, not multi-user identity. Bootstrap via existing HTML page GET / outside API contract. Reuse valid cookie across tabs; no mint per reload. Signing secret stable env (>=32 random bytes), never model/client/log. Payload contains random32byte nonce, issued_at, expires_at and server-bound workspace_id; session MAC domain 'session:v1:' differs from CSRF. Reject expired signature/binding before effects.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: CSRF proof bound to current signed session; POST requires BOTH cookie and header. Token derived HMAC(signing secret, 'csrf:v1:' + session nonce), exposed only in same-origin HTML/RAM, not localStorage. Restart with same secret preserves session/token until8h expiry; rotate secret invalidates sessions, reopen page before same-key replay. Origin/Host also checked; OpenAPI scheme does not enforce those checks.

x-design-deltas: Initial HTTP API version /api/v1; health remains /health. Existing all-POST /api/tools transport is a prior proposal, not supported legacy alias.
3 read tools move to GET path/query; 9 mutations remain named POST tools.
Unsafe Idempotency-Key UUIDv4 maps request_id; body request_id rejected. Header normalized to lowercase UUID before scope lookup; body UUIDs canonicalized to lowercase for hashing.
Problem response replaces transport Error envelope. Internal service adapter may retain legacy Error shape; do not return Error at HTTP boundary.
Transport 400/405/413/415 reject before claim, no receipt/run. HTTP500 INTERNAL_ERROR durable extension requires DB receipt CHECK500 and service Error enum extension.
planned_period added from DB proposal: optional day default in input, required in output; UI selecting week must send explicitly.
Cookie name, maxAge8h, stable signing-secret/HMAC-bound CSRF bootstrap/reuse are explicit proposals; no session table/login accounts.
x-processing-order: Validate Host, session, same-origin Origin/CSRF before business data/receipt for POST.
Validate media type, <=256KiB raw body, JSON syntax, input schema and normalize defaults/UUIDs.

Compute tool+canonical normalized domain-input SHA256; lookup receipt before mutable current-version/target checks. Same key/hash replay even if workspace version advanced since original request. Normalize all UUID values/lowercase, fill planned_period=day, sort JSON object keys/encode UTF8 without whitespace; preserve array order/text, do not normalize strings.
On new key, perform current-version/reference/authorization checks and claim request under short workspace lock; bound model call outside DB transaction; commit results atomically.
x-internal-error-policy: After claim and before success commit with DB healthy: rollback failed work, then lock workspace/run/request, finalize receipt500 INTERNAL_ERROR and run failed; no raw detail persisted. Same key replays terminal error, no inference.
If success already committed, never replace receipt/artifact with error. Return transport500 if response cannot be produced; replay same key returns durable success (or expired chat reply).

If cleanup/commit outcome cannot be confirmed because DB unavailable:503 DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE, may leave in_progress for startup interruption. Never claim success or auto-retry new key; replay same key after recovery.

INVALID_INPUT.title: Invalid input
INVALID_INPUT.recovery: Sửa dữ liệu; yêu cầu có receipt lỗi đã kết thúc cần UUID mới khi gửi lại ý định đã sửa.
INVALID_INPUT.receipt_behavior: Pre-claim reject: no receipt. Valid newly claimed intent failing business validation: finalize sanitized terminal error without artifacts.

FORBIDDEN.title: Forbidden
FORBIDDEN.recovery: Kiểm session/CSRF/Origin/quyền workspace; lỗi trước claim không tạo receipt.
FORBIDDEN.receipt_behavior: Pre-claim reject: no receipt. Valid newly claimed intent failing business validation: finalize sanitized terminal error without artifacts.

NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
NOT_FOUND.recovery: Kiểm ID; run không tồn tại không chứng minh cần UUID retry mới.
NOT_FOUND.receipt_behavior: Pre-claim reject: no receipt. Valid newly claimed intent failing business validation: finalize sanitized terminal error without artifacts.

VERSION_CONFLICT.title: Version conflict
VERSION_CONFLICT.recovery: Đọc bản hiện tại rồi gửi thao tác được xác nhận bằng UUID mới.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.title: Idempotency conflict
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.recovery: Cùng key khác canonical input/tool; không đổi payload để retry key cũ.
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.receipt_behavior: Reject mismatching payload/tool; leave original receipt/hash/run/artifact unchanged.

RUN_BUSY.title: Run busy
RUN_BUSY.recovery: Key đang chạy: kiểm run/replay cùng key. Key mới bị từ chối: người học chờ và chủ động dùng UUID mới.
RUN_BUSY.receipt_behavior: Same key in_progress: transient response, receipt unchanged. Different/new key rejected by one-running-run gate after claim: terminal receipt409 with no run for that key.

LOCAL_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.title: Local model unavailable
LOCAL_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.recovery: Bật runtime rồi retry chủ động bằng UUID mới nếu request trước đã terminal.

MODEL_TIMEOUT.title: Model timeout
MODEL_TIMEOUT.recovery: Kiểm runtime còn inference không; không tự chạy lại. Terminal retry cần UUID mới.

INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT.title: Invalid model output
INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT.recovery: Không lưu output lỗi; người học có thể yêu cầu lượt mới bằng UUID mới.

CONTEXT_LIMIT.title: Context limit
CONTEXT_LIMIT.recovery: Giảm context hoặc chọn kỳ ngày; không âm thầm cắt nguồn.
CONTEXT_LIMIT.receipt_behavior: Pre-claim reject: no receipt. Valid newly claimed intent failing business validation: finalize sanitized terminal error without artifacts.

RESULT_EXPIRED.title: Result expired
RESULT_EXPIRED.recovery: Reply chat tạm hết hạn; không tạo reports lại. Chỉ gửi câu hỏi mới khi người học yêu cầu.
RESULT_EXPIRED.receipt_behavior: Computed on chat replay after RAM expiry; leave completed-success receipt and reports/run unchanged.

INTERRUPTED.title: Interrupted
INTERRUPTED.recovery: Giữ artifacts đã commit; người học retry chủ động bằng UUID mới.

DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Database unavailable
DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE.recovery: Khi DB khỏe, replay đúng key trước vì kết quả commit có thể chưa rõ.

MALFORMED_REQUEST.title: Malformed request
MALFORMED_REQUEST.recovery: Request không parse được; từ chối trước claim.

METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Method not allowed
METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.recovery: Dùng method được khai báo; từ chối trước claim.

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.title: Payload too large
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.recovery: Body trên 256 KiB; từ chối trước claim.

UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.title: Unsupported media type
UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.recovery: POST phải application/json; từ chối trước claim.

INTERNAL_ERROR.title: Internal error
INTERNAL_ERROR.recovery: Nếu đã claim và chưa commit, kết thúc run/receipt khi DB khỏe. Replay cùng key trước nếu kết quả commit chưa rõ.

x-invariants.same_origin: POST requires exact configured Origin and Host allowlist before claim; GET reads require signed cookie, no CORS wildcard.
x-invariants.context: max40000UTF8bytes, max3000outputTokens, at most2attempts within120seconds; response budget125s/browser130s are proposals from system design.
x-invariants.immutable: No model edit to profile/goals/activity/submission. Rewrites insert new submission. Journal revisions append-only.
x-invariants.privacy: No transcripts/recent_messages/source_quote/raw prompt/provider error text in DB/log/history/long-term HTTP cache. Learned reports and explicit correction instruction are permitted compact artifacts.
x-invariants.pagination: before_id absent means first page, default limit20/max50, descending ID, next_before_id|null. Collections in workspace are bounded snapshots, not full history pagination.
x-invariants.success_replay: Non-chat replay returns exact original success/status snapshot; ordinary reads recompute journal stale status. Chat reply livesRAM<=10minutes; expires/restart returns409RESULT_EXPIRED with original run_id, does not overwrite success receipt.
